FI-AIM-01.name: Performance degradation under data drift (runtime distribution departs from training: seasonal appearance, resurfacing, new signage).

FI-AIM-02.name: Concept drift: learned input-output relationship no longer valid after operational change.

FI-AIM-03.name: Susceptibility to adversarial-like physical patterns (stickers, imagery, projected patterns).

FI-AIM-04.name: Overconfident output on out-of-distribution input (no uncertainty flag raised).

FI-LOC-03.name: Coordinate-system misalignment between components (Sensing / PCP / VI).

FI-LOC-04.name: Offline map incorrect or stale vs reality.

FI-LOC-05.name: Incorrect lane assignment (ego located in wrong lane of the carriageway).

FI-PCP-01.name: Lane markings not detected (no lane data provided to VI).

FI-PCP-02.name: Lane markings detected with insufficient precision or inconsistent performance.

FI-PCP-04.name: Incorrect lane position / geometry estimate delivered (lateral position, curvature).

FI-PCP-05.name: False positive lanes accepted (fake / shadow / skid-mark lanes).

FI-PCP-06.name: Actor / object not detected (OMV, VRU, static obstacle missed).

FI-PCP-07.name: Actor provided too late (perception latency in collision-critical situation).

FI-PCP-10.name: Incorrect object classification (incl. EMV not recognized / non-EMV taken for EMV).

FI-PCP-12.name: Unstable / intermittent detection under intermittent occlusion.

FI-PCP-13.name: Speed limit not detected or incorrect value provided.

FI-PCP-14.name: Traffic sign / signal not detected or misclassified (incl. temporary signage).

FI-PCP-15.name: Incorrect ego state / local pose estimate.

FI-PCP-16.name: Incorrect trailer position / configuration (or trailer in wrong coordinate frame).

FI-PCP-17.name: Degradation under specific environmental conditions not compensated (rain, fog, night, glare, shadows, low contrast).

FI-PCP-18.name: Out-of-distribution / unseen object class not handled safely (no safe default).

FI-SEN-01.name: A sensor stream provides no data (dropout / outage).

FI-SEN-02.name: Sensor data of insufficient quality (resolution, SNR, range) for the downstream task.

FI-SEN-03.name: Sensor configuration / calibration incorrect (wrong parameters, drift).

FI-SEN-04.name: Sensor mounting misaligned / data in unexpected coordinate frame (incl. factory mispositioning).

FI-SEN-05.name: IMU data incorrect, absent or insufficient (ego-motion estimation input).

FI-SEN-07.name: Vehicle Control feedback data incorrect or absent (ego actuation state unknown to planner).

FI-SEN-08.name: Trailer not (fully) covered by sensing: no or partial trailer data in the sensor set.

FI-VI-01.name: Plans trajectory following an incorrect ego lane (propagates FI-PCP-04 / FI-LOC-05).

FI-VI-02.name: Plans trajectory leaving the ego lane to satisfy constraints (false-positive avoidance, MC constraints).

FI-VI-03.name: Does not plan / freezes when required inputs are missing (no lane lines -> no trajectory).

FI-VI-04.name: Wrong prediction of other actor motion / intent (adjacent, opposite, VRU).

FI-VI-05.name: Incorrect traffic-rule application (right-of-way, speed rule, move-over, gap acceptance).

FI-VI-06.name: Replanning too late for a dynamic change (cut-in, intrusion, lane shift).

FI-VI-07.name: Incorrect assumption on own capability envelope (braking / steering limits vs load, adhesion, grade).
